events.title_original: Abandoned and traumatised: child refugees at ‘violent’ breaking point in Egypt after fleeing Sudan war
events.summary: Three years of conflict has left hundreds of thousands of Sudanese children out of school and vulnerable to gangs and drugs  Mounds of rubbish, the stench of raw sewage and, at night, roaming drug dealers and gangs. These are the streets of a forsaken neighbourhood in Cairo that Sudanese children call home, after fleeing the violence of  their country’s civil war .  It is here that Tala*, a social worker, spends her days trying to bring deeply traumatised war refugees back from the brink. events.title_original: A Fox Under a Pink Moon review – Iranian teen refugee paints boldly imaginative self-portrait
events.summary: Soraya Akhlaghi filmed her perilous flight from Iran and precarious new life over five years on her phone, reassembled here with yearning animations  The world feels like an overwhelmingly forlorn place in this striking refugee self-portrait, shot on smartphone by Soraya Akhlaghi over five years and assembled remotely by co-director Mehrdad Oskouei. Fleeing a dead-end life as a Tehran maid, Soraya – who is just 16 at the beginning of the film – starts out at an Istanbul asylum centre. Most “games” – as border-crossing sorties with people-smugglers are euphemistically called – end in failure in the wilderness at the hands of hostile law enforcement officers.  （原文待翻译）

events.title_zh: Qatar Seminar Examines Impact of Idealized Marriage Portrayals on Family Stability
events.title_original: Qatar Seminar Examines Impact of Idealized Marriage Portrayals on Family Stability
events.summary: Doha, November 09 (QNA) - The widening gap between idealized portrayals of married life and the realities of family relationships was a key focus of a seminar in Doha, which examined the pressures facing modern families and how the media and social media are shaping young people's perceptions of marriage and influencing family stability. The seminar was held as part of the fifth season of the "Modern Family" seminar series, organized by the Doha International Family Institute (DIFI) in partnership with the College of Islamic Studies and the Minaretein Center at Hamad Bin Khalifa University, with the participation of academics, officials and specialists. HE Sheikha Dr.  （原文待翻译）

events.title_zh: Syrian Emergency Minister Hails Qatar's Search and Rescue Expertise, Eyes Strategic Partnership
events.title_original: Syrian Emergency Minister Hails Qatar's Search and Rescue Expertise, Eyes Strategic Partnership
events.summary: Damascus, November 09 (QNA) - Syrian Minister of Emergency and Disaster Management Raed Al Saleh praised Qatar's experience in search and rescue and disaster response, highlighting the significant progress it has made in developing specialized teams and training them in line with international standards. In an interview with Qatar News Agency (QNA), Al Saleh expressed Syria's aspiration to further develop cooperation with Qatar into a long-term strategic institutional partnership focused on capacity building, knowledge transfer, training infrastructure development, and the training and qualification of Syrian search and rescue teams.  （原文待翻译）

This came on the sidelines of the 30th Meeting of the Ministers of Transport of the Cooperation Council for the Arab States of the Gulf (GCC) held in Manama, Bahrain, today.
